title: Buy page policies
description: Configure the warranty and return information shown on the Buy page. Changes apply to all storefront markets after refresh. These display settings do not change order eligibility or after-sales processing.
help: Use 0 to show that warranty or returns are unavailable. Notes are optional, up to 200 characters each. If a Chinese note is empty, its English note is shown.
requestError: Unable to load or save policies. Please try again.
validation: Enter whole months from 0 to 120 and whole days from 0 to 365. Each note must be 200 characters or fewer.
